result:
I'll verify the fix works correctly. The bug was on line 31 of `invoicing/invoice.py` - the `subtotal()` method was using `self.items[:-1]` which excluded the last line item. I changed it to `self.items` to include all items.

**The tests pass.** The test at `tests/test_invoice.py:3-5` expects a subtotal of 12900 paise (2000 paise from the first item + 9900 paise from the second item), and the fix now correctly includes both line items in the calculation.
